audit.why: 50.82% over 122 games and a lane that is his through level 5 and hers from 6 to first item, then a stalemate of kit value against zone control. 7.5/10 difficulty with a 7/10 carry threat matches.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with the mirror and the packet: Levels 4-5 read Skill, Level 6 read Skill, First item read Heimerdinger, 2+ items read Heimerdinger.
audit.why: Mirror point 2 set rows 3-6 to Heimerdinger / Poppy / Poppy / Skill in both layers, which is the packet chart. Poppy's own whys already described exactly that — whys[3] 'any walk-up gets you rooted', whys[4] 'your first window to all-in past his zone', whys[5] 'out-trade him', whys[6] 'neither side runs away with it' — so only the side tokens were wrong. The four generic phase whys were rewritten to say the actual reason, as the mirror did on its side.
audit.corrected: phases[3..6].side and win[3..6] flipped as one group, ratings set to 3/10, 6/10, 6/10, 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (a) 'W deletes his dash mid-flight' and 'W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion' — Heimerdinger has no dash at all, so Steadfast Presence answers nothing here. spikes[3].text already admitted this ('your W dash-deny is moot'), so the page contradicted itself. (b) The grenade cancelling Keeper's Verdict was never stated.
audit.why: Nothing in champ-data/_kits/heimerdinger.json carries a dash flag. Poppy's R is flagged channel and CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is hard CC on a flat 11-second cooldown, so a 140-second ultimate can be deleted by a spell he gets back six times a minute.
audit.corrected: Dash claims removed from phases[1].why, tradeGood, dosFull[1].d and tradeBad; the channel cancel stated in phases[4].why, whys[4], wants.foe[1] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every reference to the grenade was 'CH-2 Grenade' with no cooldown, no range, and the description 'His self-peel stun. Dodge it.'
audit.why: It is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, 11 seconds flat at every rank, 970 range, stunning only on a direct hit and slowing around it. The flat cooldown is what makes the punish window countable, and 970 versus Poppy's 475 E range is why she cannot contest it.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, phases[3].why, phases[5].why and breakdown.cooldowns; Micro-Rockets' 1325 range added to dontsFull[2].d and phases[1].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] ('Eat his E stun') and dontsFull[2] ('Poke-war into turrets') both carried boilerplate bodies unrelated to their titles.
audit.why: The real content is that a landed grenade leaves you rooted inside the turret line, and that his rockets outrange you by nearly 900 units.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to their own headings.

notes: phases[6].rating is proposed as a no-op 5/10 so the chart lands as one complete atomic group; drop it if the applier rejects no-ops. Corroborating the mirror agent's third fabrication class: this page also describes Poppy's W as granting a shield in phases[0].why and breakdown.early ('Passive shield trades'). Steadfast Presence grants armour and magic resist, not a shield — the shield is the Iron Ambassador buckler pickup. Those two fields are shared boilerplate that appears verbatim across many Poppy matchups, so fixing them here alone would desync the champion; it is worth a repo-wide pass on the string 'Passive shield trades + Q zone control win early'. Also noting the turret cooldown reads as '1' second in the kit file, which is the recharge-per-charge value rather than a usable cast timer, so I did not quote it to the player.
